purpose: Native process-memory phase attribution and embedding-configuration diagnostics; no production configuration changes.
snapshot_artifact: Compressed status, smaps and smaps_rollup files are preserved under the memory_diagnostic test undeclared outputs in each linked BuildBuddy invocation.
snapshot_digest_algorithm: SHA-256 of UTF-8 sorted relative gzip paths, each followed by NUL, SHA-256 of the gzip bytes, and newline.
caveats: Both engines use one combined executable and -Xmx512m; this is not a standalone executable footprint comparison.
Timing uses fresh processes separate from profiling and forced application GC.
smaps_rollup.Rss is current RSS. status.VmHWM is a separately accounted Linux lifetime high-water counter and may lag sampled smaps RSS.

MemoryMXBean heap accounting is application-isolate only. Native .27 non-heap counters can be invalid; null plus non_heap_error retains those unavailable measurements. Shared-compiler positive readings are also unreliable before the getter starts throwing.
These measurements use unchanged 67921ff production code; they do not measure later library optimizations.

metadata.native_image: serial GC, optimization 3, combined executable containing both engines
metadata.timing: separate process; fixed 524288 evaluation warmup; seven >=150ms samples
metadata.notes: smaps_rollup.Rss is current resident process pages; status.VmHWM is lifetime peak. MemoryMXBean heap counters describe application isolate, not compiler isolate. Native .27 non-heap usage counts RuntimeCodeInfoMemory (generated code and metadata). Application System.gc does not collect a separate compiler isolate. Mapping categories do not establish isolate ownership. Forced GC and idle phases are diagnostics, not deployment defaults. Closing the Polyglot context does not necessarily dispose the standalone target's fallback engine. truffle-standalone means the context-free Java API within the same combined executable, not a standalone binary.
